verdict.rationale: The API returns structured account/transaction/ownership data with documented endpoints, categorized data segments, enrichment (transaction types, recurring transactions, spending insights), webhooks for real-time events instead of polling, and even an llms.txt plus MCP server for AI-tool consumption, suggesting agent-friendly design. However, evidence doesn't confirm JSON schema specs (e.g. OpenAPI/JSON Schema files) are published for automated validation, nor explicit claims that enrichment fields eliminate heuristic parsing for downstream agents. missing for 10: published JSON schema/OpenAPI spec details, explicit confirmation that enrichment output requires no heuristic interpretation, independent/hands-on validation of agent consumption quality.
